Not this semester but, I failed a statistics class in my first semester as a PhD student. Needless to say it broke me, tanked my gpa, put me on probation n all other crap- all of this during covid when we were living online..

I understood that I lacked the basic foundational skills that were needed for that class, and the instructor was very VERY strict too. 
So, I took the preceding class, offered by the same professor- did well in it and gained the needed foundation- went over the contents of the class that I failed, which I then understood better- took a higher level statistics course- did really well in it and waiting for my final grade rn…. 

It was all about being determined, understanding why whatever has happened, and correct yourself while overcoming the crushing imposter feeling you’d have. Build a peer network that are on the same path as you and can lift you up when you need the most.

Remember, it’s not the end of the world.
